review_method: Full frames at conditioning times plus unconditioned midpoints 0.5,1.5,2.5,3.5,4.5 seconds. Direct source/generated crops at 1.5 and 2.5 seconds. Full MP4 decoded; human normal-speed acceptance pending.
positive: Camera, vehicle placement, scene layout and distinct main characters stay close to the Blender guide, including inspected frames between conditioning images.

failures.finding: Generated driver leans/stretches differently from source during emergence; sparse images do not enforce exact contact mechanics.
Foot positions and leg transition differ from guide, with visible soft/ghosted edges in the crop.

inherited_guide_limits: Proxy cast, stretched/approximate reaching arm and simplified seat-to-standing animation. Correct those before claiming a production-quality guided action.
limits: Extra conditioning relative to other models. Canonical likeness and full normal-speed motion acceptance not assessed.
